title: Application of Massachusetts Electric Company under the provisions of G. L. c. 164, § 94G1/2 and the Company's traiff, M.D.P.U. No. 528, for approval by the Department of Public Utilities of a change in the Comapny's Oil Conservation Adjustment charge to be billed to the Company's customers pursuant to meter redings taken in the billing months of April, May and June 1988, The Oil Conservation Adjustment surcharge recovers the cost of conversion from oil-fired to coal-fired generation and its calculation is based of the respective costs of burning coal and oil.
